The quantum chemistry of systems like enzymes is not well understood because enzymes are flexible structures of many atoms in a condensed phase, containing little empty space, and so are difficult to analyze with Schrödinger’s equation (Schatz & Ratner, 1993; Bader, 1990; Parr & Yang, 1989)

The movements of the substrate, product, and enzyme must also be understood, presuma- bly as a result of electromechanical models, like Langevin equations (Kramers, 1940; Gardiner, 1985; Hynes, 1985; 1986; Hänggi, Talkner & Borkovec, 1990; Fleming & Hänggi, 1993)
